product_details.materials_or_construction_summary: Silicone cable clips are supplied as input. No adhesive type, dimensions, durability, safety certification or universal fit is established.
product_details.fulfillment_and_refund_assumptions: Workflow assumption: overseas fulfillment, typically 1 to 2 weeks; shipping is included in prices and supplied costs. Confirm actual delivery capability before publishing. No customer-facing guarantee or keep-the-item refund promise is approved. Propose clear support and merchant-approved refund terms; the zero-return-shipping convention is internal only. product_details.recommended_primary_product_name_rationa: Describes a small resting place for a cable without reusing ReferenceBrand. All suggested names are fictional test concepts; trademark and availability checks have not been performed.

given_inputs: Synthetic target_market_country NZL resolves to NZ; currency NZD is supplied independently, not inferred.
First retail set cogs_per_unit = NZD 6.00; each extra set in the same order = NZD 2.00; shipping is included.
Caller-specified illustrative tax: 10% of tax-exclusive selling price, included in displayed price. This is test data, not an assertion about NZ tax.
Caller-specified illustrative processing fee: 2.9% of total customer charge plus NZD 0.30 once per order.
Input material: silicone cable clips. Competitor reference about cable placement is not verified product proof.
modeled_assumptions: Synthetic arithmetic fixture, not researched market advice. Research was not used; there is no actual conversion, review, sales or ad-performance evidence.
Proposed prices NZD 22.00 / 33.00 / 44.00 include the illustrative tax. One unit means one retail set; exact clip count is unknown.
Hypothetical order mix: 50% one-set, 35% two-set, 15% three-set orders; weights total 100%. This is not an observed sales mix.
Assume CPC NZD 0.40, LPV/click 90%, checkout-start/LPV 12%, purchase/checkout-start 40%. These are uncalibrated test assumptions, not country or category benchmarks.
Assume a NZD 5.00 contribution buffer per order before unmodeled overhead/refund losses. This is a scenario guardrail, not a universal profit target.
Keep unrounded intermediate values; show NZD monetary outputs to two decimal places, rates to needed precision. Per-offer unrounded components are exposed for audit.

Overseas fulfillment 1 to 2 weeks and zero return shipping are workflow assumptions pending operational confirmation. App charges, refund principal, chargebacks and fixed overhead are excluded, not proven zero.
Three segment priorities are qualitative hypotheses; the common acquisition model is not a validated segment forecast.
pricing_economics_and_offers.landed_cost_model: Synthetic tax-inclusive scenario: R=P; T=P*0.10/1.10; F=0.029*R+NZD 0.30 once per order; C_n=NZD 6.00+(n-1)*NZD 2.00; L=C_n+T+F; contribution M=R-L. One set: R NZD 22.00, C NZD 6.00, T NZD 2.00, F NZD 0.938, L NZD 8.938, M NZD 13.062 (NZD 13.06 displayed). Two sets: R NZD 33.00, C NZD 8.00, T NZD 3.00, F NZD 1.257, L NZD 12.257, M NZD 20.743 (NZD 20.74 displayed). Three sets: R NZD 44.00, C NZD 10.00, T NZD 4.00, F NZD 1.576, L NZD 15.576, M NZD 28.424 (NZD 28.42 displayed). At 50%/35%/15% mix: gross AOV NZD 29.15; blended C NZD 7.30, T NZD 2.65, F NZD 1.14535; blended L NZD 11.09535 (NZD 11.10); blended M NZD 18.05465 (NZD 18.05). Tax is deducted once using gross revenue; all excluded losses remain outside this contribution model.
pricing_economics_and_offers.recommended_single_unit_selling_price: Proposed base-case NZD 22.00 including caller-modeled tax and shipping. Not a validated market price; test willingness to pay and actual product quality before launch.

direct_purchase_funnel_model.assumed_cpc: NZD 0.40 per click; synthetic assumption, not observed performance.
direct_purchase_funnel_model.assumed_checkout_start_rate: 12% = 0.12 checkout starts per LPV; synthetic assumption.
direct_purchase_funnel_model.assumed_purchase_rate: 40% = 0.40 purchases per checkout start; synthetic assumption.
direct_purchase_funnel_model.break_even_blended_cpa: NZD 18.05465 = NZD 18.05, equal to modeled blended contribution before advertising and excluded losses.
direct_purchase_funnel_model.recommended_target_blended_cpa: NZD 18.05465 - NZD 5.00 buffer = NZD 13.05465 = NZD 13.05; hypothetical planning ceiling, not an observed result.
direct_purchase_funnel_model.funnel_logic_explanation: At 1000 clicks, assume spend NZD 400.00, 900 LPVs, 108 checkout starts and 43.2 expected purchases; NZD 400.00 / 43.2 = NZD 9.26 CPA. These are expected cohort values, not fractional observed purchases. Base-case contribution after acquisition is NZD 18.05465 - NZD 9.259259... = NZD 8.80, before excluded losses. Estimated CPA is below the target NZD 13.05 and break-even NZD 18.05 only under these assumptions. Sensitivity: purchase-per-checkout-start falling to 25% gives 2.70% click-to-purchase conversion and NZD 14.81 CPA, missing the target while leaving only NZD 3.24 modeled contribution. Validate checkout completion, cost per click and offer mix; do not present this untested scenario as profitable fact.

diagnostic_metrics.estimated_cost_per_lpv: NZD 0.40 / 0.90 = NZD 0.44 per LPV; diagnostic, not CPA.
diagnostic_metrics.estimated_cost_per_checkout_start: NZD 0.40 / (0.90 * 0.12) = NZD 3.70 per checkout start; diagnostic, not CPA.

asset_needs.asset_detailed_description: Planned photo: show the actual cable-keeper set at a tidy working desk with one unplugged charging cable placed within reach. Frame the product and connector large enough for a narrow mobile crop and leave a clean text area above the hand position. Use a real sample and a compatible surface confirmed by the merchant; do not depict an unverified mounting mechanism. Pair the image with the proposed primary product name and a simple use-case description, not a quantified performance claim. This is a planned asset, not an existing photograph.

Planned short video: in one continuous, honestly timed shot, show a charging cable before placement, the actual verified setup steps, and retrieving the connector after placement. Keep hands, product and cable in frame and use close-ups rather than invented outcome captions. Confirm fit, attachment method and surface suitability before filming. The video must show only the real product behavior and must not imply permanent adhesion or damage-free removal without tests. Provide a mobile crop and a still poster so the offer remains understandable when video does not play.

Planned fit-reference photo and label panel: photograph the actual silicone clips with a measured scale and the cable diameters or connector constraints verified by the merchant. Show installation method only after it is confirmed. Use clear, large labels for compatible uses and exceptions; do not call the product universal. The visual should answer fit and surface questions before a shopper chooses a bundle, and should stay legible without zooming on a phone.

Planned offer comparison graphic: display one retail set, two retail sets and three retail sets at the proposed NZD 22.00, NZD 33.00 and NZD 44.00 tax-inclusive prices, respectively, only once merchant pricing is approved. Explain that a set is the supplied cost unit and confirm its contents before depicting clip quantities. Connect two sets to two distinct stations rather than fake popularity. Use no crossed-out historical price or bestseller badge. Show delivery expectation near the selection area, with touch-friendly spacing.

Planned shipping/support card: use text-first mobile layout to show the approved delivery estimate, overseas fulfillment disclosure, support route and actual refund policy link once available. Until merchant verification, the creative brief should label 1 to 2 weeks as a planning assumption and keep refund wording provisional. Do not show an invented local warehouse, secure-payment certification or keep-the-product guarantee. Repeat key delivery information beside the purchase recap.

Planned FAQ answer cards: give concise answers about clip fit, surface suitability, setup, set contents, delivery and support using only facts the business confirms. Use a verified product close-up for any answer that needs a diagram. Include space for limitations rather than hiding them below unrelated claims. Keep questions scannable on mobile and avoid testimonial screenshots or fabricated review stars.

Planned recap still: show the same real set and primary proposed offer as the ad and offer-selection module, with the approved tax-inclusive price, delivery estimate and a clear purchase CTA. Maintain the verified scale and color of the product; do not substitute a more impressive model. Leave enough spacing for mobile tap targets and do not cover shipping or support terms with a sticky control.

mobile_first_landing_page_plan.proof_strategy_without_reviews_or_real_s: Create and verify actual sample demonstrations and a measured fit guide. Do not publish invented reviews, ratings, testimonials, customers, test data or certifications. Before/after must reflect the same genuine setup without overstating results. No proof asset currently exists in this synthetic example.
